messages:
asha: Heads-up — saw intermittent OOMs on maelstrom12b canary around 20:00 PDT. Only for long prompts (>1k tokens) and when batch_window_ms = 50. Repro rate ~1.4% on canary traffic.

matt: logs?

asha: paste log snippet:
```bash
2026-03-01T03:14:22Z server: oom: alloc failed on device 0, slab free 12MB, requested 48MB
stack: ... kv_cache_len=24576 max_new_tokens=512 batch_window_ms=50
```

jen: looks like fragmentation — we talked about slab compaction cadence. Are we compacting on evict? what's kv_prefetch setting?

asha: kv_prefetch=true for long seqs. Can reproduce by sending 2x prompts 1200+ tokens back-to-back.

kai: quick experiment — lower max_new_tokens default for maelstrom12b to 128 and set batch_window_ms=10 for canary. Also flip kv_prefetch to 'adaptive' to avoid prefilling huge KV for long tails.

perf-bot: Canary metrics (last 30m): OOM count: 7 -> after patch predicted drop ~80% based on sim run. 99th latency +5ms due to smaller batching.

matt: +1 to the changes. We should also enable slab_compaction_interval=30s for the canary group.

jen: add a soft reservation for slot_reserve_mb=64 for session-cache to avoid coldstart spike.

kai: config snippet I'll push:
```json
{"model":"maelstrom12b","defaults":{"max_new_tokens":128,"batch_window_ms":10,"kv_prefetch":"adaptive","slab_compaction_interval_s":30,"slot_reserve_mb":64}}
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued to canary cluster 'eng-ml-canary-2' by kai

asha: testing now, will report back in 10m :eyes:

perf-bot: smoke result: canary OOM count -> 0 across 40k requests, tail latency +3ms, cost per token ~-1.2%

matt: nice. let's roll to phased rollout 10% -> 50% over 2hrs if stable. create a PR to update model catalog defaults and add an eval that tests long prompt behavior.

jen: PR created: github.com/redwood/ml-configs/pull/1423 :rocket:

asha: closing loop — saving prompt set to /evals/maelstrom-longprompts.json and scheduling nightly regression. Thanks all :tada:
